generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.
DECLARATIONS: The bidder shall submit the duly signed declaration furnished in the bid document.

The bidder is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders. The departments shall not be responsible for non-accessibility of Karnataka public procurement portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches at bidders end

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
The original documents should be produced for verification at any stage of tender process as and when sought for, failing which, the bids are liable for disqualification
Rates shall be quoted in price schedule in the website itself
The tender document is part and parcel of the agreement Condition.
Conditional tenders are liable for rejection.
The successful bidder shall give an undertaking that they would abide by the provisions of the Employees Provident Fund Act.
The bidder shall obtain insurance coverage for all the workers deployed for this work.

The bidder shall quote his rates exclusive of GST but inclusive of all other applicable taxes, levies, duties and Building Workers Welfare Cess at 1% etc., as per the latest GoK and GoI prevailing as on the last date of submission of bid.
The bidder shall quote his rates inclusive of PF as per the applicable rate as issued by the PF department from time to time.
KPCL shall recover the Income Tax, building workers welfare cess, at the prevailing applicable rates.

The bidder should take into account the prevailing royalty charges while quoting their rates. The successful bidder shall strictly adhere (GoK circular no. Dated 07.11.2023) to Rule 36 & 42 of Karnataka Mineral Concession Rules 1994 & its amendments thereof. If the successful bidder/agency fails to furnish documents related to remittance of royalty charges for Coarse aggregate, Fine aggregate, murrum etc., as per Rule 44(4) of Karnataka Mineral Concession (amendment) Rules 2023, prevailing royalty charges along with following penalty will be recovered from the work bills. a) A penalty of 5 times the royalty amount & additional payment (AP) of 40% royalty amount to Department of mines and Geology. b) A penalty of 10% of royalty amount and the same will be transferred to District Mineral Foundation Trust.

The bidder should maintain register of workers deployed and wages paid for the workers and shall produce the documents whenever called for by the competent authority. Remittance towards PF shall be commensurate with the labour component of the work involved.
Bidder should have independent PF code. The bidder shall remit PF of labourers to Contractors permanent PF code number only and not to the KPCL PF sub code.
In case the dates notified above declared as holiday, the immediate next working day will be reckoned.
If the Bidder makes any alterations in the conditions of the contract or puts any condition of his own, such tenders are liable for rejection.

The bidder shall register himself under section 7 and their workers who will be engaged for the works under section 12 of the Building and other construction workers (Regulation of employment & conditions of services) Act 1996.
Corrigendum/modification/corrections, if any, will be published in the web site only.
The bidder shall quote item rates on the basis of prevailing market rate.

Bidders shall give declaration regarding payment of fair and reasonable wages which shall not be less than the minimum wages fixed by the government from time to time to the labours working under the contractor in the contract undertaken by him. Failing which, the bids are liable for rejection.
Any variation in labour wages made by the Government from time to time shall be borne by the agency. Any claim towards this variation will not be entertained by KPCL.
The successful bidder shall obtain ESI coverage for all the workers deployed for this work if required.

KPCL reserves the right to verify any information/document furnished by the bidder should the circumstances so warrant in the overall interest of the Corporation. In case the information or the documents furnished are found to be incorrect or invalid, then tenders of such bidders will be cancelled and the EMD furnished by such bidders will be forfeited.
Any revision in GST rates during execution of work will be paid to the contractor by KPCL or recovered from the bills of the contractor.

In case of death of a contractor after executing the agreement/ commencement of the work, his legal heir (to be intimated at the time of execution of agreement by the successful contractor), if any eligible registered contractor and willing, can execute and complete the work at the accepted tender rates irrespective of the cost of the work after obtaining approval from competent authority.

The successful bidder shall execute the agreement by furnishing Contract performance guarantee (CPG)/Security deposit (SD) equivalent to 5% of the Contract amount in the form of DD/NEFT or e-Bank Guarantee from Bank which are integrated with NeSL (National e-Governance Services Limited) Portal from the successful bidder acceptable to the Corporation, Insurance Surety Bonds issued by Insurance Company authorized by Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India within 20 days of receipt of letter of intent (e-proc).
Contract performance guarantee (CPG))/Security deposit (SD) should be valid for 30 days after the date of completion of defect liability period.

Work completion period is 04(Four) months excluding monsoon. Defect liability period for the work is 12 (Twelve) months from the date of completion. Contract period is 16 (Sixteen) months i.e. Work completion period plus Defect liability period.
If Tender has engaged in corrupt or fraudulent practices, action shall be initiated Financial Department, Government of Karnataka Notification No.FD 884 Exp 12/2019, Bengaluru, dated 7th May 2020.

Further details of the work or any clarifications can be obtained from the office of the Executive Engineer (Civil), Gerusoppa, Karnataka Power Corporation Ltd., Honnavara Taluk, Uttarakannada District -581384. Mobile-9141610500

technicalCriterionList.description: The indenting bidder should have satisfactorily completed (at least 90% of the contract value) as a prime contractor at least one Concrete road work of value not less than Rs. 19.07 Lakhs during the preceding five financial years i.e., 2021-2022, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26. The past experience should be supported by original scanned copy of the Work done certificate issued from state/central Government/Government under taking from the officers not below the rank of Executive Engineer. (Work done of previous financial years shall be given weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the price level of the financial year in which the tender is invited).

The intending bidder should have achieved in at least Two (02) financial years an average annual financial turnover Rs. 38.14 Lakhs in the last 05 (Five) financial years i.e., 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26. Turnover certificate, duly certified by chartered Accountant (along with UDIN No) shall be furnished. (Financial turnover of previous financial years shall be given weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the price level of the financial year in which the tender is invited)

itemList.description: Earth work in surface excavation by mechanical means for lowering & leveling the ground for all works other than foundation in all kinds of soils & upto depth not exceeding 300mm as per drawing and technical specifications, including setting out, shoring, strutting, barricading, caution lights, removal of stumps and other deleterious matter including dressing of excavated surfaces, disposing off or levelling the excavated earth or sorting & stacking the selected earth for reuse in a radius of 50 m and lift upto 1.5 m including cost of labour, tools, usage of machinery & other appurtenances required to complete the work.

Preparation and surface treatment of formation by removing mud and slurry, watering to the extent needed to maintain the desired moisture content, trimming to the required line, grade, profile and rolling with 8-10 t smooth wheeled roller, complete as per clause 310

Construction of Granular Sub-Base of required grading as per design mixing in a mechanical mix plant at OMC, carriage of mixed Material to work site, spreading in uniform layers with motor grader on prepared surface and compacting with vibratory power roller to achieve the desired density, complete as per clause 401.(V) For Grading -V Material

Wet Mix Macadam (Plant Mix Method): Providing, laying, spreading and compacting graded stone aggregate to wet mix macadam specification including premixing the Material with water at OMC in mechanical mix plant carriage of mixed Material by tipper to site, laying in uniform layers with paver/grader in sub-base / base course on well prepared surface and compacting with vibratory roller to achieve the desired density.

Providing and constructing un-reinforced plain cement concrete pavement, thickness as per design, over a prepared sub base, with 43 grade cement or any other type as per Clause 1501.2.2 M30 (Grade), coarse and fine aggregates conforming to IS:383:2016:, maximum size of coarse aggregate not exceeding 25 mm, mixed in a concrete mixer of not less than 0.2 cum capacity and appropriate weigh batcher using approved mix design, laid in approved fixed side formwork (steel channel, laying and fixing of 125 micron thick polythene film, wedges, steel plates including levelling the formwork as per drawing), spreading the concrete with shovels, rakes, compacted using needle, screed and plate vibrators and finished in continuous operation including construction joints, primer, sealant, curing of concrete slabs for 14-days, and water finishing to lines and grade as per drawing and technical specification clause 1501 with all lead, lifts, loading & unloading charges, cost and conveyance of all materials, labour, equipments etc., complete. as per the directions of the Engineer-in-charge of the work

Cutting transverse contraction joints 3 to 4 mm wide and depth 60mm in concrete slab using concrete cutting machine with diamond studded saw within 48 hours of casting of bay / slab etc. complete including subsequent widening of the groove 8 to 10 mm. wide at top having depth of 15 mm. as directed by Engineer incharge.

Providing to contraction joints polysulphide sealant (Pouring grade) confirming to BS : 5212 - 1989 into sawed groove widened at top for sealant reservoir of specified size and shape as per detailed drawing including fixing Polyethylene foam backer rod of required diameter (approx. 25% larger than the initial 3 mm.to 4 mm. joint) overlaid with bond breaking tape as per detailed drawing. Item includes cleaning the joints with water jet / air compressor and allowing joint to become thoroughly dry before sealant is applied and applying primer. (A) Contraction and longitudinal joints (15 mm. deep x 8 mm.wide).

Construction of unlined surface drains of average crosssectional area 0.40 m2 in soil to specified lines, grades, levels and dimensions. Excavated material to be used in embankment with a lift upto 3m and lead of 50 m (average lead 25 m) as per Technical Specification Clause 307. Mechanical Means

Construction of sub-grade and earthen shoulders with approved material obtained from borrow pits with all lifts & leads, transporting to site, spreading, grading to required slope and compacted to meet requirement of table No. 300-2

Providing and erecting direction and place identification retroreflectorised sign as per IRC:67:2022 made of high intensity grade sheeting vide clause 801.3, fixed over aluminium sheeting, 2 mm thick or Aluminium composite material sheet with overall thickness of 4mm with area not exceeding 0.9 m2 fixed over back support frame of min 35 x 35 x 3mm angle mounted on a mild steel circular pipe 65 NB, firmly fixed to the ground by means of properly designed foundation with M25 grade cement concrete 45 x 45 x 60 cm, 60 cm below ground level as per approved drawing
